gloss_en: The rectification (tikkun) of the aspect of the 'zaken' (זָקֵן, the elder — God's appearance as an elder at Sinai, per Rashi on 'Anokhi'), accomplished through beginning charity anew, and identified in Torah lm2:4 with the festival of Shavuot ('be-shavuoteichem'); by this rectification the nursing of the 'forehead of the snake' is nullified
